title: Blacked-out blue van to an underground training school
place_text: Undisclosed facility near the NSA complex, Maryland

plain: Dan Sherman, an Air Force sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, says that between 1990 and 1993 he was driven in an unmarked blue van with blacked-out windows from a facility to an underground training school near the NSA complex in Maryland. He tells Michels this as something he went through himself, linking it to an officer he names as Captain White: "It was a blue unmarked van that had black windows. It drove to the school."
